items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: But I did know the bass, the bass drummer in the snap drummer. Abbie Williams and the young mob.

ctx.x: I didn't know the clarinet played.

No, no, neither did I. He didn't play it when I was in 45 and 56 with us. I think that's Anderson's young cousin. See, he's just starting out. And I didn't even know the other trumpet fella, Alfred knows him. But I did know the bass, the bass drummer in the snap drummer. Abbie Williams and the young mob. Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. Trombone player didn't show up. We had a trombone book.
